label: Dual-Site-Binding Ligand-Driven (100) Orientation for Efficient and Stable Perovskite Solar Cells.
summary: Regulating crystal orientation is a powerful strategy for enhancing the optoelectronic performance of perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, most existing approaches rely on single-site ligand binding, which not only forms insulating layers that hinder charge transport but also involves weak coordination that limits orientation control.
